reason: With 5 to 10 staff I cannot watch every bill, so seeing cancelled bills and the cash that should be in the drawer from my phone is worth ₹500 a month to me. They also bill customers who won't give a number, they train my girls in Odia, and if the stylists don't use it I get the second ₹5,000 back, so I would try it, but I will still ask for a discount on the setup.
objection: The first ₹5,000 is gone even if it fails, and I don't like monthly fees. After 2 years the price can go up, and my stylists may slip back to the register once the person who set it up stops coming.
